newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon accepts four election appeals.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon accepts four election appeals.

text.p: Lebanon's Constitutional Council accepted on Monday four appeals against the results of last year's parliamentary elections and ordered new elections for the four seats, a source at the constitutional court said.
The court cancelled the elections of a Sunni deputy and three Maronites including Minister of Culture and Higher Education Fawzi Hobeish, the source added.
Rulings would be officially announced after parliament, interior ministry and concerned MPs have been informed of the results, the source added.
The results came in the absence of the former head of the council who resigned last month amid reports that the 10-member court was facing political pressure over the appeals.
Eighteen losing candidates have asked the court to overturn results and declare them winners. Another has asked to cancel the entire election.
